question.text: A research analyst must disclose the use of:

answer.text: Only Microsoft Excel in data analysis
Artificial Intelligence tools in providing research services

explanation.text: The Logic: Regulation 19(vii) on page 280 of the NISM XV workbook requires a research analyst or research entity to disclose to the client the extent of use of Artificial Intelligence tools in providing research services. The same AI-tool disclosure is repeated in the RA Investor Charter on page 328. The Trap: The regulation specifically names AI tools. The other distractor items (Excel, Bloomberg, Reuters) are not picked out for disclosure by this regulation. Note: Source-backed by Regulation 19(vii) on pages 280 and 328 of NISM Series XV Research Analyst Workbook (February 2026).
